description: Express.js route definitions for development environment, including database status, seeding data, index management, and verification endpoints for MongoDB collections related to user, session, deployment, and LLM costs.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/db-status
methods.description: Returns MongoDB connection status including host, database name, and connection state.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed
methods.description: Seeds sample data into multiple collections if they are empty, including users, samples, tenants, projects, sessions, and deployments.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/verify
methods.description: Verifies data availability by returning counts and sample documents from collections.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed-llm-costs
methods.description: Seeds 90 days of LLM cost entries for at least 3 models if collection is empty.
